cohort: The study included 165 participants (55 VTE cases and 110 controls without VTE) recruited from Imam Sadiq Teaching Hospital in Babylon, Iraq.
finding: The study found a high correlation between obstructive sleep apnea syndrome, cesarean sections, oral contraceptives, and renal disease with Venous Thromboembolism (VTE).
mod_finding: A history of cesarean operation was found to have a significant correlation with VTE risk.
